citations.text: Szklarczyk et al. (2019). STRING: functional protein association networks. Nature Methods.

description: Undirected, weighted network of human protein interactions. Nodes represent proteins, edges represent confirmed physical interactions. Edge weights represent confidence scores (0-1) from interaction prediction methods and experimental evidence aggregation. Heavily connected biological network useful for studying scale-free properties in real biological systems.
name: Human Protein-Protein Interaction Network
